name: ruting-wang-academic-website
description: Academic website for Dr Ruting Wang

scripts.cv:build: mkdir -p tmp/pdfs/cv-build output/pdf public/docs && cd cv && latexmk -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=../tmp/pdfs/cv-build ruting-wang-short-cv.tex && latexmk -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=../tmp/pdfs/cv-build ruting-wang-full-cv.tex && cp ../tmp/pdfs/cv-build/ruting-wang-short-cv.pdf ../output/pdf/ruting-wang-short-cv.pdf && cp ../tmp/pdfs/cv-build/ruting-wang-full-cv.pdf ../output/pdf/ruting-wang-full-cv.pdf && cp ../tmp/pdfs/cv-build/ruting-wang-short-cv.pdf ../output/pdf/ruting-wang-cv.pdf && cp ../tmp/pdfs/cv-build/ruting-wang-short-cv.pdf ../public/docs/ruting-wang-short-cv.pdf && cp ../tmp/pdfs/cv-build/ruting-wang-full-cv.pdf ../public/docs/ruting-wang-full-cv.pdf && cp ruting-wang-short-cv.tex ../public/docs/ruting-wang-short-cv.tex && cp ruting-wang-full-cv.tex ../public/docs/ruting-wang-full-cv.tex && cp ../tmp/pdfs/cv-build/ruting-wang-short-cv.pdf ../public/docs/ruting-wang-cv.pdf && cp ruting-wang-short-cv.tex ../public/docs/ruting-wang-cv.tex
